### The critical dimension difference

| | MediaPackage **v1** (classic) | MediaPackage **v2** (Next-Gen, `/userguide/`) |
|---|---|---|
| Doc path | `mediapackage/latest/ug/` | `mediapackage/latest/userguide/` |
| Org model | Channel is top-level | Channel lives inside a **Channel Group** |
| Egress scoping dimension | `Channel` **used alone** is valid (value = channel GUID) | `Channel` **alone is NOT a valid dimension** — it must always be paired with `ChannelGroup` |
| Valid `EgressBytes` dims (v1) | No Dimension, `Channel`, `Channel`+`OriginEndpoint`, `StatusCodeRange` (alone or with `Channel`/`OriginEndpoint`) | No Dimension, `ChannelGroup`, `RequestType`, `ChannelGroup`+`Channel`, `ChannelGroup`+`Channel`+`OriginEndpoint`(+`RequestType`/`MultiviewLayout`), `MultiviewLayout` |

**The core pitfall:** v2 introduces a new required dimension, `ChannelGroup`, that didn't exist in v1. In v1, `Channel` alone fully scopes a metric.
